lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.20 - A Look and learn

details: Look and learn builds recognition of the meaning, form, and pronunciation of ‘do you’ questions and sentences through a grammar box activity.
Look for confident reading and repetition of both questions and short answers with clear form and pronunciation.
“We need to make our school more welcoming! Perhaps we could play music when people come in. Fill in these gaps to find out what instruments people can play.”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.20 - B. Check and write

details: Check and write builds on students’ grammar box knowledge as they refer to the box to complete questions and sentences.
Look for accurate ticking, question and sentence completion, correct spelling and neat handwriting.

lessonPlan.topic: Phonics Book P.112 - A Read and say

details: Read and say develop phonics and speaking skills by having students read and say words with the vowel combinations ‘a_e’ and ‘i_e’.
Look for eye movement and clear pronunciation as students read the words.
“I think people will want to come to our school more, if we play more games. Let’s play Bingo today!”
